published.citation: Dupuy et al. (2023), MNRAS 519, 1688, section 4: the best-fitting BT-Settl model to the pair's combined spectrum, 2700 K on a 100 K grid (the four neighbouring models bound the fit), https://arxiv.org/abs/2208.08448

temperature.note: The star has no Gaia XP spectrum or catalogue temperature of its own that describes it alone, so the colour is a Planck spectrum at the temperature its paper publishes; the range in the prepared report is the colour at the lower and upper bounds.
